import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from jinja2 import Environment, TemplateSyntaxError, TemplateAssertionError
from jinja2.ext import ConditionalI18nExtension, InternationalizationExtension

env = Environment(extensions=[InternationalizationExtension, ConditionalI18nExtension])
env.install_null_translations()

# Test from task description: condition with comma
tpl = env.from_string('{% ctrans use_i18n, count %}{{ count }} item{% fallback %}{{ count }} plain{% endctrans %}')
print('Comma cond:', repr(tpl.render(use_i18n=True, count=3)))
print('Comma cond false:', repr(tpl.render(use_i18n=False, count=3)))

# Condition with parens / and
tpl2 = env.from_string('{% ctrans (a and b) or c %}Yes{% fallback %}No{% endctrans %}')
print('(a and b) or c [a=1,b=0,c=1]:', repr(tpl2.render(a=1, b=0, c=1)))
print('(a and b) or c [a=0,b=0,c=0]:', repr(tpl2.render(a=0, b=0, c=0)))

# Multiple variables with mixed commas
tpl3 = env.from_string('{% ctrans flag, x, y %}{{ x }}-{{ y }}{% fallback %}fx-{{ y }}{% endctrans %}')
print('Multi vars:', repr(tpl3.render(flag=True, x=1, y=2)))
print('Multi vars false:', repr(tpl3.render(flag=False, x=1, y=2)))

# Variable assignment with expression
tpl4 = env.from_string('{% ctrans ok name=first ~ " " ~ last %}Hi {{ name }}!{% fallback %}yo{% endctrans %}')
print('Expr assign:', repr(tpl4.render(ok=True, first='Ada', last='Lovelace')))

# Fallback-only variables (vars in fallback not in singular)
tpl5 = env.from_string('{% ctrans ok %}Static{% fallback %}Dyn {{ fb }}{% endctrans %}')
print('Fb var true:', repr(tpl5.render(ok=True, fb='X')))
print('Fb var false:', repr(tpl5.render(ok=False, fb='X')))

# Unclosed at various points
for src, label in [
    ('{% ctrans ok %}Hi', 'unclosed singular'),
    ('{% ctrans ok %}Hi{% pluralize n %}', 'unclosed plural'),
    ('{% ctrans ok %}Hi{% fallback %}', 'unclosed fallback'),
]:
    try:
        env.from_string(src)
        print(f'ERROR {label}: no exception')
    except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
        print(f'{label}:', e.message)

# Missing fallback (endctrans right after singular)
try:
    env.from_string('{% ctrans ok %}Hi{% endctrans %}')
    print('ERROR: missing fallback no exception')
except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
    print('missing fallback:', e.message)

# Missing fallback (endctrans after plural)
try:
    env.from_string('{% ctrans ok n %}Hi{% pluralize n %}Hs{% endctrans %}')
    print('ERROR: missing fallback after plural no exception')
except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
    print('missing fallback after plural:', e.message)

print('ALL DONE')
EOF

args.oldString:
"""Adds a ``ctrans`` tag that conditionally renders translations based on a
    runtime boolean condition, with a mandatory fallback block.

    .. code-block:: html+jinja

        {% ctrans use_i18n name trimmed %}
            Hello {{ name }}!
        {% pluralize count %}
            Hello {{ name }}s!
        {% fallback %}
            Hi {{ name }}!
        {% endctrans %}

    When ``use_i18n`` is true the translation path (``gettext``/``ngettext``)
    is rendered, otherwise the fallback content is rendered directly with
    variable substitution.
    """
args.newString:
"""Adds a ``ctrans`` tag that conditionally renders translations based on a
    runtime boolean condition, with a mandatory fallback block.

    .. code-block:: html+jinja

        {% ctrans use_i18n count name %}
            Hello {{ name }}! You have {{ count }} item.
        {% pluralize count %}
            Hello {{ name }}! You have {{ count }} items.
        {% fallback %}
            Hi {{ name }}!
        {% endctrans %}

    When ``use_i18n`` is true the translation path (``gettext``/``ngettext``)
    is rendered, otherwise the fallback content is rendered directly with

    """
